result.title: A Simple and General Approach to top-$k$ Selection
result.summary: This paper considers the Bayesian top-$k$ identification problem, wherein a decision maker is tasked with selecting $k$ items from a pool of items of unknown quality. To assess the items, the decision maker adaptively allocates a fixed sampling budget, where each sample of an item yields a noisy observation of its quality, with the objective of minimizing the expected opportunity cost of the selected set. We propose an approach that allocates each batch of samples by minimizing a surrogate objective derived from an upper bound on the expected opportunity cost. The approach is general: samples can be allocated in batches, the selection size $k$ is arbitrary, and it applies to many sampling distributions. It is also simple and intuitive. We prove that the method's posterior expected opportunity cost decays at an exponential rate of at least half the best rate achievable by any sampling rule. In simulations across a wide range of settings, the method is competitive with, and often improves upon, the best existing algorithm in each setting.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究贝叶斯 top-k 识别问题：在固定采样预算下自适应地分配对候选项目的噪声采样，通过最小化期望机会成本上界导出的代理目标来决定每批采样，并证明其后验成本以至少最优速率一半的指数速率衰减，模拟中与各设定下最好的现有算法相当或更优。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属于远离多模态的序贯决策/资源分配理论，但「预算受限下把采样分配给不确定候选」的问题表述可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与算力分配（何时继续取证据、何时停止）存在概念对应，可供核查其代理目标与速率分析能否迁移到 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本–收益刻画。
